source_brief.target_audience: Self-directed retail traders, comfortable with charts, sensitive to fees

campaign_summary: Showcasing the precise, fee-sensitive trading experience for savvy investors, these concepts utilize dynamic compositions and targeted messaging to engage self-directed traders.

concepts.strategic_idea: Empower traders by highlighting their control over fee reduction.

visual_direction.description: A dynamic, hero-left composition with a chart in motion, capturing a sense of control and precision.

copy_package.headline: Trade Your Strategy, Keep Your Gains
copy_package.subheadline: Stop letting high fees control your trades.
